description.value: Subcity Donair is a BC-based donair and sub chain with a Westside Kelowna location on Industrial Road. The restaurant is known for beef and chicken donairs made with top sirloin and a proprietary blend of 23 herbs and spices, served with a choice of seven sauces. A dedicated veggie menu including freshly prepared falafel and vegetarian pita makes it a flexible refuelling stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for https://subcity.ca/location/westside/ successfully loaded and confirms address (#103-1195 Industrial Rd., West Kelowna, BC), phone (1.250.769.4353), and active operations. The About and Menu pages confirm vegetarian options (falafel, vegetarian pita) and the 'Order Online' link combined with the fast_food OSM tag confirms takeout service. No evidence on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag has malformed Saturday value ('Sa 10:00-06:00' — likely should be 18:00) and a trailing ':00' on Sunday ('Su 11:00-16:00:00'); website confirms correct hours. OSM data may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast food business with a confirmed address and operating website; a practical food and refuelling stop for touring cyclists in West Kelowna.
